QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Runaway
QuestInfo.0: Surana dashes out of the Eluna Express following a big argument with Eremos. Where did she go?
QuestInfo.1: Surana contacted you from Fantasy Theme World! She's a bit shaken up after the disagreement and needs a little support. Wander Fantasy Theme World with her while she collects her thoughts.
QuestInfo.2: Surana's had a chance to reflect and deeply regrets her behavior. It seems she wants to apologize to Eremos and return to the Eluna Express.
